description: List the tenant's customer price lists, as the Price lists page does: name, code, status (Draft, Active or Archived), validity window (validFrom through validUntil, tenant-local days, both included), whether it prices today, whether its prices are net (no discount taken off), how it prices unlisted items, whether it is the tenant default, and its active line and assignment counts. Filter by status or a name/code search. With priceList (id or code) it also returns that list's assignments and one page of its lines (linesLimit default 100, max 500). To see what a customer pays, call resolve_customer_price. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential and a User.

includeInactiveLines.description: With priceList: true also returns inactive lines.

linesLimit.description: With priceList: lines per page (default 100, max 500).

priceList.description: Optional price list id (GUID) or code: add its assignments and a page of its lines.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive substring of the name or code.

status.description: Optional status filter: draft, active or archived.

name: list_price_lists
title: List Price Lists
